data.description: A serialized array of all relational (not in cassandra) data found during recursion

model.description: A record of all the traversed references. Helpful for visualizing how things are related.

cassandraKeys.description:
recursiveFetch does not fetch any Cassandra types but instead collects all the Cassandra-type + partition keys here.
You can use to this information fetch the cassandra objects on your own.
